summary: This bill requires the Department of Homeland Security to biennially update its northern border threat analysis and strategy, and to provide classified briefings to Congress on these analyses, while also mandating the development of performance measures for Air and Marine Operations effectiveness at the northern border.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses entirely on enhancing security and threat analysis along the northern border, which directly relates to controlling who and what enters the country. It mandates regular updates to threat analyses and strategies for border security, aligning with the goal of securing borders.
